scope: Resource target-pool partitioning and battle-script candidate filtering/selection.

validation.case_scope: A compact four-resource fixture checks category pool counts, stable candidate order, self exclusion, numeric threshold/min/max/group filters, duplicate field matches, pending-action filtering, inventory availability, random selection ABI, result writeback and nonvolatile state. Remaining filter arms are source-reviewed; concrete runtime resource lookup, property predicates and random service remain guest boundaries. Guest stack arrays retain source size assumptions and original duplicate/tie behavior, without new validation guards. Logical/ABI recovery only, not Full72, bitwise FP or gameplay proof.
